evaluation.summary: Mastra is an unusually strong match for Paarth's desired work: production agents, workflows, memory, evals, tracing, deployment, and agent reliability. The company has strong open-source traction, credible founders, enterprise usage, $35M in funding, and a globally distributed team. There is no published engineering internship or engineering vacancy, so this is a speculative internship-to-full-time proposal rather than an application to a live role.
strengths: Times Astro production conversational AI experience serving 30000+ monthly paying users
Langfuse tracing, model evaluation, feedback analysis, and large conversation-dataset experience map directly to Mastra Studio
Renderperk ownership across 11 microservices, queues, databases, CI/CD, observability, and 30+ parallel GPU workloads
Mastra's agent runtime, workflows, memory, evals, observability, server, and deployment surface directly match the target domain
Open-source contribution provides a credible proof-first path into a team that values shipping
gaps: Primary production stack is Python/FastAPI/LangGraph rather than TypeScript and Node.js
No meaningful Mastra contribution or production deployment yet
No published engineering internship or engineering opening currently exists
India employment or contractor eligibility is not explicitly confirmed
unknowns: Whether Mastra will consider an off-cycle paid intern from India
Whether a successful internship can explicitly convert to full-time
Compensation, equity, work-hour overlap, and contract structure
Which platform or observability roadmap item is suitable for an external contributor
Whether engineering hiring will reopen soon
evaluation.outreach_angle: Do not ask generically for an internship. Lead with production agent reliability: 30000+ paying users, Langfuse/evals, tens of millions of conversations, distributed systems, and production incidents. Show a Mastra-native reliability artifact and propose a paid 8-12 week trial with explicit full-time conversion criteria.
evaluation.proposed_artifact: Build a Mastra production-reliability starter that runs a stateful tool-using agent with Postgres-backed memory, deterministic workflow replay, failure injection, trace-linked evals, cost and latency budgets, and a regression dashboard. Publish a concise benchmark and contribute one focused fix or adapter upstream after discussing an issue with maintainers.

pipeline.next_action: Build a small Mastra reliability artifact and open one scoped contribution discussion before sending a personalized internship-to-full-time proposal to Abhi Aiyer.
pipeline.notes: No live engineering internship was found. Do not mark outreach or application as sent until Paarth explicitly confirms it.
